title: Washington Place; campaign activities.
bodyText: The governor shall not allow Washington Place to be used for any events intended to solicit funds, support, or votes for any candidate for elective public office.
bodyHtml: [§84-13.5]  Washington Place; campaign activities.  The governor shall not allow Washington Place to be used for any events intended to solicit funds, support, or votes for any candidate for elective public office. [L 2002, c 46, §1]
